design: DESIGN-8 (owner-approved direction 2026-10-29): build 447, single-node requests, steps 1-4
objective: same result as the newest top model at its highest reasoning, with less quota

pool_units.anthropic_shared: Cw: % of the Claude weekly pool (all models)
pool_units.openai_codex: Px: % of one Codex Pro weekly pool

cost_shape_source: a route is priced before it runs: the answer shape is every turn of two calls or fewer, whatever its realized output (review of 447); a workspace writer whose reading does work (a design, write or action task, or a workspace or execution need) is priced agentic (Core)

exchange.formula: price(pool) = max over the pool's open windows w of ttr_w / remaining_w; remaining_w = 1 - used_w/100; ttr_w = (resets_at_w - now) / window_length_w
exchange.source: lead correction 2 (DESIGN-8, 2026-10-29): each pool priced by the share of its remaining allowance until its reset, from the providers' rate-limit data (routing_law.pools, the host's observations); no 1:1 and no headroom-threshold constant
exchange.stale_fallback: missing, stale (past the host's valid_until_ms) or reset-crossed data: the pool's smallest dispatchable remaining share with the whole window ahead (price 1 / remaining); no share at all: 1 (pace); an exhausted window: no price (the pool cannot be drawn)

p_fail_inheritance: lead correction 1 (DESIGN-8, 2026-10-29): a row admitted with evidence (b or c) has its own pool reference's p_fail for the family until its own judged runs move it, at the prior's weight: (f_c + runs_prior * p_ref) / (n_c + runs_prior); a reference's own failures are priced with its own repair (itself); the local row (owner order, no evidence) keeps its own Laplace estimate

value_of_information.pass_rule: an answer passes when the local model grades every item of its frozen checklist as met; a question is informative when the audit reference's answer passes; FAIL when any question has the reference passing and the cell failing (a discordant pair); PASS when there is none and at least n questions are informative; else INCONCLUSIVE (never admits; more questions are planned)
value_of_information.source: DESIGN-8 step 6 moved into 447 (lead correction 3): horizon 7 days and the cap <= 1% of a pool's weekly allowance per week are DESIGN-8's; the confidence of the minimal-n bound is declared here (n = ceil(ln(1 - confidence) / ln(1 - b)))

effort_label_source: O4 (owner 2026-10-29): the Claude app labels Max '3.5x or more usage'; applied against the next-lower step and only ever raising cost

local_admission.source: DESIGN-8 migration row 447 'local-first'; DESIGN-6 O2 (ask-back), DESIGN-7 §1.5 (local first)
local_admission.evidence_gap: no deterministic verifier, matched-tier benchmark or REVAS paired audit exists for the local model yet

F3x.name: workspace or office document explanation, standard or deep, not code

F10.name: routing self-test without a task (ask back)

conditions_source: tiers.json's conditional tiers (review of 447: none is dropped). A condition the reading can express is its predicate: 'the file is code' / 'a large code file or a repository' = domain coding; 'solve graduate-level science problems' = a science reading that is not an explanation; 'multi-step agentic work on a repository' / 'deep / multi-step build' = the node writes, executes or is read deep; 'graduate-level technical depth' = deep. A condition no reading can tell ('asserts specific facts', 'medical', 'charts/figures', 'an open/novel problem', 'GUI operation') applies always: the floor. An unread request (no reading) meets every reading clause.
